name: Elise Karinshak
evidence: Correct person confirmed: first author of 'LLM-GLOBE' (arXiv 2411.06032), whose Schwarzman College capstone 'LLM Cultural Alignment: Proposing a Benchmark and Evaluating Chinese and US LLMs' (with Microsoft Research Asia) is the same work; she is a UGA graduate and Schwarzman Scholar, now a business analyst at McKinsey. Two affiliation-anchored routes failed: a shared-paper query on LLM-GLOBE naming all three co-author rows returned no author block, and a query on her name + Georgia Tech/institution + email returned no address (and showed her affiliation is Tsinghua/Schwarzman, not Georgia Tech). The paper's own author block was unreachable - arxiv.org and ar5iv.labs.arxiv.org are egress-blocked, as was the lacuna.tiptreesystems.com mirror. Free fetch of the benchmark repo README (raw.githubusercontent.com/raovish6/LLM-GLOBE) succeeded but contains only the BibTeX citation, no contact address. No candidate address of any kind surfaced.
